```{=html}
<header class="lab-nav">
  <a class="brand" href="https://www.skhgroup.net/">SKH <span>Research Group</span></a>
  <nav aria-label="Course navigation"><a href="https://www.skhgroup.net/teaching/2105623/">2105623 · Course</a><a href="../books/volume-1/">Volume 1</a><a href="../books/volume-2/">Volume 2</a></nav>
</header>

<main class="lab-page">
  <div class="lab-heading">
    <p class="mono eyebrow">Teaching / 2105623 / Interactive companion</p>
    <h1>Optimization Lab<span class="heading-dot">.</span></h1>
    <p class="lab-lede">Make a prediction. Change an assumption. Explain the decision.</p>
    <p class="mode-note"><span class="status-dot"></span><span id="library-count">47 problems · Loading verified cases</span> · Exact prepared results · No interpolation</p>
  </div>

  <section class="problem-browser" aria-label="Choose a workbook problem">
    <div><label for="volume-choice">Volume</label><select id="volume-choice"><option value="1">Volume 1 · 29 problems</option><option value="2">Volume 2 · 18 problems</option></select></div>
    <div class="problem-select"><label for="problem-choice">Problem</label><select id="problem-choice"></select></div>
    <div class="problem-actions"><button id="previous-problem" type="button">← Previous</button><button id="next-problem" type="button">Next →</button></div>
  </section>

  <div id="loading" role="status">Loading the checked case library…</div>
  <div id="experiment" role="region" aria-labelledby="experiment-title" hidden>
    <div class="experiment-intro"><div><p class="mono" id="experiment-tag"></p><h2 id="experiment-title"></h2><p id="experiment-description"></p></div><a id="chapter-link" class="chapter-link" href="../books/volume-1/">Read the worked chapter ↗</a></div>
    <div class="experiment-grid">
      <aside class="control-panel" aria-label="Experiment controls">
        <p class="step-label">01 · Predict</p><h3>Before you reveal</h3>
        <label for="prediction" id="prediction-label">How will the objective change?</label>
        <select id="prediction"><option value="">Choose a prediction</option><option value="up">Higher than baseline</option><option value="same">Approximately unchanged</option><option value="down">Lower than baseline</option></select>
        <p class="control-help">A prediction is for reflection, not a grade.</p>
        <div class="control-divider"></div>
        <p class="step-label">02 · Experiment</p><h3>Change the assumptions</h3>
        <div id="parameter-controls"></div>
        <button type="button" class="primary-button" id="reveal">Show prepared result →</button>
        <button type="button" class="text-button" id="reset">Reset to baseline</button>
        <p class="control-help">Every selectable combination was solved with Pyomo + HiGHS. This lab retrieves that exact result; it does not run a live solver.</p>
      </aside>
      <div class="result-panel">
        <div class="result-heading"><p class="step-label">03 · Observe</p><span id="case-status" role="status" aria-live="polite">Baseline shown</span></div>
        <div class="lab-metrics">
          <div class="lab-metric primary-metric"><p id="objective-label"></p><strong id="objective-value"></strong><span id="objective-delta"></span></div>
          <div class="lab-metric"><p id="secondary-label"></p><strong id="secondary-value"></strong></div>
          <div class="lab-metric"><p id="tertiary-label"></p><strong id="tertiary-value"></strong></div>
        </div>
        <div class="chart-card"><div class="chart-toolbar"><label for="chart-choice">Explore the plan</label><select id="chart-choice"></select></div><div id="chart" role="img" aria-label="Baseline and selected case comparison"></div><p class="chart-caption" id="baseline-description"></p></div>
        <p id="prediction-feedback" class="feedback" role="status" hidden></p>
        <div class="interpretation"><p class="step-label">04 · Interpret</p><p id="interpretation"></p></div>
      </div>
    </div>

    <div class="lower-grid">
      <div>
        <details open><summary>Check the solution</summary><div id="checks"></div><p class="control-help">Binding inequalities exclude equalities and variable bounds. Changed variables may reflect alternative optima. Checks use a 10⁻⁶ tolerance in model units. Solver optimality applies to the stated assumptions.</p></details>
        <details><summary>Read the equations</summary><div id="equations"></div></details>
        <details><summary>Data and assumptions</summary><p id="assumptions"></p><div id="result-table" class="table-scroll"></div></details>
      </div>
      <div class="reflection-panel"><p class="step-label">05 · Explain</p><h3>A question to take away</h3><p id="challenge"></p><label for="reflection">Your explanation</label><textarea id="reflection" rows="4" placeholder="What changed, which constraint matters, and why?"></textarea><div class="export-actions"><button type="button" id="export">Download experiment</button><a href="assets/lab-models.zip" download>Get the Python models ↗</a></div><p class="control-help">Notes stay in this page. Download before switching experiments, resetting, or leaving. The file contains the displayed inputs and outputs.</p></div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="book-strip"><div><p class="mono">Continue reading</p><h2>Two volumes. One modeling workflow.</h2></div><a href="../books/volume-1/">Volume 1 <span>29 worked problems ↗</span></a><a href="../books/volume-2/">Volume 2 <span>18 process challenges ↗</span></a></div>
  <footer class="lab-footer">Energy Storage Innovation Laboratory · Chemical Engineering · Chulalongkorn University<br>Interactive companion to the Quarto workbooks. Prepared cases are reproducible from the downloadable Python sources.</footer>
</main>
```
